description: This file is a Markdown document that provides documentation for Playwright's experimental Android automation support, specifically for JavaScript (js). It includes an overview, example scripts, and API method documentation related to Android devices, launching servers, connecting, and device operations.

methods.name: Android.connect
methods.description: Attaches Playwright to an existing Android device using a WebSocket endpoint, with optional headers, slow motion, and timeout settings.

methods.name: Android.devices
methods.description: Returns a list of detected Android devices connected via ADB, with options to specify host, port, and driver installation behavior.

methods.name: Android.launchServer
methods.description: Launches a Playwright Android server that clients can connect to via WebSocket, with options for device selection, host, port, and security path.

methods.name: Android.setDefaultTimeout
methods.description: Sets the maximum default time for all methods accepting a timeout parameter.
